name: macbrowse
description: Browse the Mac Browse directory of Mac apps. List published apps, or list them by App Store category, with descriptions, tags, price details and links.

interface.shortDescription: Browse a directory of Mac apps
interface.longDescription: Mac Browse is a directory of Mac apps organised by the same categories as the App Store for Mac. This plugin lists the published apps, either all of them or one category at a time, with each app's description, tags, price details and links. It is read-only: it does not need an account, does not submit listings and does not take payments. App text is written by the makers. Mac Browse is not affiliated with Apple.
defaultPrompt: Use Mac Browse to list the productivity apps for my Mac.
Which developer tools are listed on Mac Browse?
Show me the free apps in the Mac Browse directory.

positive.prompt: Use Mac Browse to list all the apps in the directory.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published apps sorted by name with their links. The directory has no published listings yet, so today this returns an empty list and the assistant should say so without inventing apps.

positive.prompt: Use Mac Browse to list the productivity apps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published apps in Productivity. The directory has no published listings yet, so today this returns an empty list and the assistant should say so without inventing apps.

positive.prompt: Which developer tools are listed on Mac Browse?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published apps in Developer Tools. The directory has no published listings yet, so today this returns an empty list and the assistant should say so without inventing apps.

positive.prompt: Show me the free apps in the Mac Browse directory.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only published apps whose price type is free. The directory has no published listings yet, so today this returns an empty list and the assistant should say so without inventing apps.

positive.prompt: Compare the utilities listed on Mac Browse.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare published Utilities apps using only the returned fields. The directory has no published listings yet, so today this returns an empty list and the assistant should say so without inventing apps.
